svg.aria-label: FROG default ring dropdown list realization template
svg.title: FROG Default Ring Dropdown List Realization Template
svg.desc: Semantic SVG template for the host-rendered ring popup list. The runtime repeats option_row, option_label, and option_selection_face for each visible ring item.

rect.style: fill: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-fill, #ffffff); stroke: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-border, #64748b); stroke-width: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-border-width, 1px); vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;

text.style: fill: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-option-text, #111827); font-family: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-option-font-family, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-option-font-size, 14px); font-weight: var(--frog-ring-dropdown-option-font-weight, 400);
